families.family: int_dequant_matmul (A16Wn / A8Wn / A8W8, grouped or channel/block scaled)
open_decisions: packing: K packed into int32 (default; 8/16/64 possible), element k at row k//e, bit shift (k%e)*W_nbits (LSB-first), e=packing_bits/W_nbits, W_nbits in {1,2,4,8}; 16-bit = unpacked fp16
W_group_mode: 0 none, 1 Wq-z, 2 Wq*s, 3 (Wq-z)*s, 4 fma Wq*s+z' with z'=-z*s precomputed (rounded to meta dtype) by GemLiteLinearTriton.pack(fma_mode=True)
define reference at kernel level (z' given) or module level ((Wq-z)*s): differs by rounding of z*s
scale/zero layout (K/group_size, N), group g=k//group_size; scalar zero allowed (zero_is_scalar, integer subtraction before cast)
channel_scale_mode: 1 out*s_w[n], 2 out*s_x[m], 3 both, 5 = 128x128 weight block scales (fp32) x per-(row,128-col) activation scales (fp32), BLOCK_QUANT_SIZE=128
dequant arithmetic precision: done in meta dtype (fp16/bf16) then cast to input dtype before dot; fp64 reference dequantises exactly
accumulator dtype (fp32 default, fp16 via GEMLITE_FAST_GEMV_ACC / acc_dtype; int32 for int8xint8)
GEMV dump_b_val=0.001 pre-scale for fp16-acc 8-bit (numerical trick)

DeepSeek-V3 tech report sec.3.3 (128x128 block fp8 quant) for mode 5
families.notes: Candidate ref: Wq=unpack(B); W=dequant(Wq,s,z,mode) per group; C=A@W; then channel scaling; mode5: C=sum_kb (A_kb@W_kb)*sa[m,kb]*sb[kb,n//128]. Inputs: A fp16/bf16 (int8/fp8 when scaled_activations), K%32==0, K%group_size==0, group_size>=16. sm86: fp16/bf16/int8 paths plain tl.dot; fp8 input dtypes need sm89+. Split-K/GEMV variants use tl.atomic_add into zero-inited output (fp32 buffer when bf16 atomics unsupported, i.e. sm<90): summation order nondeterministic. Suspected issue: GEMM/GEMM_SPLITK pruners force BLOCK_SIZE_K=max(min(bk,g),32), so group_size=16 (allowed by GemLiteLinearTriton) gives BLOCK_SIZE_K>group_size and k_m=k*BK/g skips every other group. gemm_splitK_persistent_kernel is not dispatched (core uses gemm_splitK) and its launcher omits a_sizeof/b_sizeof positionally (broken); it also skips dequant when elements_per_sample==1 and has no mode 5. Bias added outside kernel.

scale layout: (N, K/g) 2D or preshuffled 5D TMA layout [1,N/128,K_S/4,2,256] (core.py pack)

families.notes: Candidate ref: (fp4/fp8 decode(Wq) * 2^(e8m0-127) or e4m3 scale) per group, same for activations, C = Xdeq @ Wdeq.T [* 1/(meta_w*meta_x) for NVFP4]. families.notes: Not imported by the package (benchmark scripts; module-level hqq/bitblas imports). Loads have no K or N masks: requires K % BLOCK_SIZE_K == 0 and N % BLOCK_SIZE_N == 0. tl.dot input_precision='ieee'.

families.reference: cols: (W.view(R, C//e, e).long() << (torch.arange(e)*nbits)).sum(-1).to(D); rows: (W.view(R//e, e, C).long() << (torch.arange(e)*nbits).view(1,e,1)).sum(1).to(D); e=packing_bits//nbits, D={8:uint8,16:int16,32:int32,64:int64}[packing_bits] (two's-complement wrap), optional .t()
families.notes: Convention (LSB-first, non-overlapping fields so sum==OR) fixed by the kernel and the library's torch twin. Inputs must be in [0, 2^nbits); no masking: requires C (resp. R) divisible by e; unroll=largest pow2 divisor (<=64). Only the over-cols variant is used (GemLiteLinearTriton.pack).

Arithmetic shift on signed containers is harmless thanks to the mask. Exposed as torch.library custom ops gemlite::unpack_over_{cols,rows}_triton; not used inside the matmul path. unpack_over_cols_torch_fake references an undefined name (num_output_cols) - fake-tensor bug only.

families.family: act_quant_nvfp4 (e2m1 packed + e4m3 scale, group 16, global meta scale)

families.notes: Writes float8_e4m3fn scales (sm89+). Dispatch: v6 fused (dynamic meta, grid<=num_SMs, atomic_max + spin-wait grid barrier using only relaxed atomics - memory-ordering of the meta_scale store is not guaranteed by fences) or v5 when meta_scale given.
